name: How does local water quality affect sink and faucet choices in the Denver metro area?

mainEntity.name: How does local water quality affect sink and faucet choices in the Denver metro area?

acceptedAnswer.text: Homeowners in the Denver metro area, Centennial, and Parker frequently deal with hard water containing minerals that cause white scale deposits around faucet aerators, cartridges, and sink drains. If your home has high mineral levels, choose faucets with scratch-resistant finishes like PVD brushed nickel or stainless steel, which resist mineral spotting better than polished chrome. Installing an under-sink filtration system or water softener during the plumbing remodel will also protect internal faucet cartridges from premature wear.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hard water in the Denver area causes mineral buildup, making PVD or brushed finishes and under-sink filtration smart investments.
